Peter Adam Hochfelder decreased its stake in Oracle Corp (ORCL) by 55.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Brahman Capital Corp sold 2.15 million shares as the company’s stock declined 4.18% with the market. The hedge fund run by Peter Adam Hochfelder held 1.72M shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $81.25M, down from 3.87M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Brahman Capital Corp who had been investing in Oracle Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $185.05 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.60% or $0.27 during the last trading session, reaching $45.33. About 1.46M shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 1.20% since May 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.35% the S&P500.
Guardian Life Insurance Company Of America increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 42.39% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Guardian Life Insurance Company Of America bought 4,980 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 16,727 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.83 million, up from 11,747 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Guardian Life Insurance Company Of America who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $920.32 billion market cap company.
